title: viorna ovata
intro: Viorna ovata, commonly known as the Viorna or Five-angled Viorna, is a plant species in the family Violaceae. It is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include providing health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, helping to alleviate conditions like fever, rheumatism, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Viorna ovata are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, that exhibit anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of Viorna ovata contribute to its potential therapeutic uses, including wound healing, cardiovascular protection, and anti-cancer activity.
